name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
title: Carborundum Universal Ltd - 513375 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone sales up 8.6% to INR 3,024 crore with H2 up 14%, but consolidated PBIT fell 25% on VAW, Foskor and Awuko losses; FY27 guide is 4–4.5% consolidated growth with capex stepping up to about INR 400 crore.

capex.quote: We expect to do a CAPEX of about INR 400 crores in FY27.

triggers.label: Standalone H2 FY26 up 14.1% YoY
triggers.quote: On a year-on-year basis, H2 FY26 grew by around 14.1% compared to INR 1,415 crores in H2 FY25.

triggers.label: China abrasive export rebate cut
triggers.quote: China has removed the export rebate on Abrasive products from 9% to 0% effective from April onwards.

triggers.label: Rhodius FY26 sales down 8.8%
triggers.quote: Rhodius Abrasives in FY26 was EUR 61 million compared to sales of EUR 67 million in FY25. This marks a decline of 8.8%.

guidance.quote: we expect the sales to grow approximately 4 % to 4.5 % in FY27.
Consolidated Abrasives margins are expected to be around 9.5 % to 10%.
Consolidated Ceramic growth is expected to be in the range of 15 % to 15.5%.
Consolidated Electrominerals sales are expected to decline by 6.5% to 7% on account of the closure of Foskor Zirconia
We expect to do a CAPEX of about INR 400 crores in FY27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: During the last call, I said the consolidated sales would go by 5.5% to 6.5%. Against this, we have recorded a growth of 6.5%.
we are now at a growth of 5.1%.
We communicated CAPEX estimate of INR 350 crores during our last calls.

red_flags.label: Ceramics growth guidance miss; deferred projects
red_flags.quote: It is largely because of deferred projects

red_flags.label: Consolidated PBIT down 25%; subsidiary losses
red_flags.quote: The majority of this decline was on account of VAW almost about INR 87 crores, Foskor a lmost about INR 22 crores

evasions.quote: We wouldn't like to share such details at this call.
I would limit my conversation to this level.
